# Rocketry Organization of California (ROC)

> > ROC is a high-power rocketry club operating at Lucerne Dry Lake, providing launch services, safety protocols, and educational resources for rocket enthusiasts in California.

The organization is affiliated with the National Association of Rocketry and Tripoli Rocketry Association, offering monthly launches and comprehensive guidance on rocket tracking, recovery systems, and launch site operations in the Mojave Desert region.

## Key Topics

- High-Power Rocketry
- Lucerne Dry Lake Launch Site
- GPS and APRS Tracking
- Rocket Recovery Systems
- Radio Transmitters and Telemetry
- Amateur Radio (Ham Radio)
- National Association of Rocketry (NAR)
- Tripoli Rocketry Association (TRA)
- Launch Safety and Liability
- Direction Finding and Rocket Tracking
- BLM Land Use Regulations
- Lucerne Valley and Victorville Area
- Launch Conditions and Weather
- Gary Schneider (ROC Leadership)
- Bluetooth Rocket Tracking

## Launch Site Information

- [Launch Site – Rocketry Organization of California](https://rocstock.org/lucerne-dry-lake-launch-site): Lucerne Dry Lake launch site info, directions, and safety requirements

## Rocket Tracking and Recovery

- [Advanced-Rocket Tracking Using Onboard Radio Transmitters – Rocketry Organization of California](https://rocstock.org/learn/advanced/advanced-rocket-tracking-using-onboard-radio-transmitters): Guide to GPS/APRS rocket tracking equipment with/without ham license

## About ROC

- [ROC Board 2025 – Rocketry Organization of California](https://rocstock.org/roc-board): ROC Board 2025 members including Gary Schneider and Mike Ostby
